# 海姆達爾級偵查飛船
[color=#a4885c]船隻尺寸：[/color] 小型
[color=#a4885c]艦隊穿梭機：[/color] 否
[color=#a4885c]建議乘員人數：[/color] 1-2 人
[color=#a4885c]動力生成類型：[/color] 等離子
[color=#a4885c]探勘任務：[/color] 無
[color=#a4885c]敵我識別控制台：[/color] 有
[color=#a4885c]最低存取等級：[/color] 偵探
「一艘小型偵探巡邏艇，專用於情報蒐集與鑑識工作。」 「配備長程掃描器，用以協助識別目標船隻並監控調查對象。」
# Ship Functions
- 駕駛艙內有一個按鈕，辦公區內也有一個按鈕。 兩者皆可控制其對應按鈕附近的快門。
# 運行 NSF Heimdall 穿梭機的提示 - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold] (kW) 為 [color=#a4885c]17 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - For the basics of [bold]cargo hauling[/bold], refer to [textlink="Cargo Hauling" link="CargoHauling"]. - For the basics of [bold]expedition diving[/bold], refer to [textlink="Expeditions" link="Expeditions"]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
